lunch2_start.name: {name}
lunch2_start.text: *I hold Yuna’s note from this morning. Its folded corners are worn from opening it between classes. I stop where the corridor branches toward the roof stairs, the basement snack shop and the library annex.*

lunch2_choice.name: {name}
lunch2_choice.text: *Second day of lunch. Whose side do I head toward?*
choices: Follow Yuna's note to the library annex
Go to the snack bar with Dain

lunch2_seo_1_check.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_1_check.text: *I follow the sunlit stairs up to the rooftop.*

lunch2_seo_1b.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_1b.text: First time you've come up to the roof today, right? Sit in the shade over here. You can hear the field below a little, but the breeze is cool. *She opens a neat lunchbox on a folding chair.*

lunch2_seo_2b_dain.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2b_dain.text: Yesterday you headed for the shop with Dain. Today you came all the way up to my rooftop.

lunch2_seo_3b_dain.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_3b_dain.text: Yesterday Dain grabbed my wrist and dragged me off. Today I wanted to walk up here myself.

lunch2_seo_4b_dain.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_4b_dain.text: Being dragged here and coming to find me yourself don't mean the same thing.

lunch2_seo_5b_dain.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_5b_dain.text: I had bread from the shop yesterday, so today I was curious how the lunch you packed tastes.

lunch2_seo_6b_dain.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_6b_dain.text: You don't talk around it. I like that.

lunch2_seo_2b_yuna.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2b_yuna.text: You took a note from Yuna this morning, and your feet still brought you to the rooftop.

lunch2_seo_3b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_3b_yuna.text: I was in the quiet library yesterday, so today I got curious about the side you're on.

lunch2_seo_5b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_5b_yuna.text: I wanted to see for myself what this rooftop breeze and the student council president's lunch would be like together.

lunch2_seo_6b_yuna.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_6b_yuna.text: *She taps the corner of the lunchbox lid with the tip of a wooden chopstick and smiles.* That excuse is strangely convincing.

lunch2_seo_1.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_1.text: *Under the same rooftop shade as yesterday, Seoyeon unties the wrapping cloth and sets the lunchboxes out side by side.*

lunch2_seo_3.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_3.text: Well, yesterday's lunch was really that good.

lunch2_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_4.text: So you came up purely because the food tasted good?

lunch2_seo_5.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_5.text: The rooftop breeze feels nice. So does the person sitting next to me.

lunch2_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_6.text: That sounds like you used the breeze as cover and slipped it in.

lunch2_seo_7.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_7.text: *Then the iron door, shut tight, clicks open, and Dain bursts in, out of breath.*

lunch2_seo_9.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_9.text: So this is where you've been hiding! Found you at last. Mind if I join your rooftop picnic?

lunch2_seo_10.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_10.text: Rooftop access requires student council permission. Besides, I got this lunch slot first.

lunch2_seo_11.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_11.text: Oh, but the door was already open! I'll take that as permission on arrival. I'm sitting down, okay?

lunch2_seo_12.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_12.text: There's an empty chair, too. This one's mine! *Dain strides over and drops into the chair across from me.*

lunch2_seo_13.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_13.text: Hey, you ate with me yesterday, and you've already switched to the president's lunchbox?

lunch2_seo_13b.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_13b.text: Hello, Madam President! This seat next to you is still free, right?

lunch2_seo_13b_b.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_13b_b.text: *Seoyeon pulls the open lunchbox a little closer to me.* You can sit down, but we're finishing our conversation first.

lunch2_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_14.text: If you're cramped over there, I'll move a little closer. *Seoyeon draws her chair right up to mine, and our arms brush through our thin shirt sleeves.*

lunch2_seo_15.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_15.text: We're all in the same class. You two already know each other well, right?

lunch2_seo_16.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_16.text: Being classmates and giving up my lunchtime are two separate things.

lunch2_seo_17.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_17.text: Oh, so that's how we're playing it? Then I'm not giving way either! Hey, come down to the gym next break.

lunch2_seo_19.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_19.text: {name}, are you making plans with someone else right in front of me while eating my lunch?

lunch2_seo_20.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_20.text: Answer her later. You've got a grain of rice by your mouth. Hold still a second.

lunch2_seo_choice.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_choice.text: *Seoyeon's slender fingers, closed around a white wet wipe, come to the corner of my mouth, close enough for her breath to reach.*
choices: I can handle this much myself.

lunch2_seo_c1_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_c1_1.text: Right. Stay still, like you are now. This won't take long. *Seoyeon's soft fingertips brush the corner of my lips, lift off the grain of rice, and fold the wet wipe so the inside doesn't show.*

lunch2_seo_c1_2_b.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_c1_2_b.text: Sorry. I was just about to grab a sausage. ...Is it really okay if I keep sitting here? *Chopsticks frozen in midair, Dain looks back and forth between the two of us, her face gone stiff.*

lunch2_seo_c1_3.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_c1_3.text: Wait. You're picking the rice off their mouth with your own hand?

lunch2_seo_c1_3_b.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_c1_3_b.text: *She folds the wet wipe once more into a small square.* A grain of rice was stuck where it showed. That's all.

lunch2_seo_c1_4.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_c1_4.text: It doesn't mean anything more than that.

lunch2_seo_c1_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_c1_5.text: Anyway, finish what you were saying. *She picks up the water bottle like nothing happened, but she never opens the cap.*

lunch2_seo_end_c1.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_end_c1.text: ...Anyway, let's finish eating first. It's going to get cold! *As if shaking off the awkwardness, Dain taps the chair leg twice with her toe.*

lunch2_seo_c2_1.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_c2_1.text: *Before Seoyeon's fingertips can reach me, I pull my head back a little and wipe the corner of my mouth with the back of my hand.*

lunch2_seo_c2_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_c2_2.text: Don't wipe it with your bare hand. I said use this wet wipe.

lunch2_seo_end_c2.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_end_c2.text: *A faint rice mark is still on the back of my hand. Seoyeon draws her hand back from the air and only unties the lunchbox cloth strap, then cinches it again.*

lunch2_dain_1_check.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1_check.text: *I match Dain's lively steps and head down toward the basement shop.*

lunch2_dain_1b.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1b.text: *Dain and I stand side by side in front of the shop. First rock-paper-scissors of the day, with today's lunch on the line.*

lunch2_dain_1b_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1b_seo.text: *The shop I step into with Dain. Yesterday it was a quiet lunchbox on the roof. Today the sweet, toasty smell of bread hits my nose first.*

lunch2_dain_2b_seo.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_2b_seo.text: Oh, yesterday you went for the president's lunchbox, and today you came to my side?

lunch2_dain_3b_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_3b_seo.text: Yesterday the president called me and showed me around from the morning, so today I wanted to try the shop bread you talked about.

lunch2_dain_4b_seo.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_4b_seo.text: Yes! You can't take that back! Come on, one round, soboro bun on the line!

lunch2_dain_1b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1b_yuna.text: *Shoved along by Dain's shoulder, I step into the noisy crowd at the shop.*

lunch2_dain_2b_yuna.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_2b_yuna.text: Hey, you were stuck in the library all day yesterday. Today you're actually going to hang out with me, right?

lunch2_dain_3b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_3b_yuna.text: I saw a quiet place yesterday, so today I should check out the liveliest one too.

lunch2_dain_4b_yuna.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_4b_yuna.text: Oh, I fully approve of that sense of balance! Then no waiting. One round, let's bet!

lunch2_dain_1.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1.text: *Back in front of the shop with Dain. A revenge round of rock-paper-scissors starts, to pay back yesterday's loss.*

lunch2_dain_2.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_2.text: I ran it in my head all night yesterday. You're losing today, no question, so be ready to open your wallet!

lunch2_dain_3.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_3.text: Pretty sure you talked just as big when we walked into the shop yesterday.

lunch2_dain_4.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_4.text: Come on, yesterday was just a light warm-up so the transfer student could save face!

lunch2_dain_5.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_5.text: *Rock-paper-scissors goes out with a shout. Today, too, Dain's hand loses, just like that.*

lunch2_dain_4b.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_4b.text: Obviously. Reflexes are the one thing I was born with!

lunch2_dain_5b.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_5b.text: *Rock-paper-scissors, called with full confidence. The result is Dain's total loss.*

lunch2_dain_6.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_6.text: Wait, this isn't actually a scam or a fix, is it? You're reading my hand off my eyes!

lunch2_dain_7.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_7.text: How do you even rig one round of rock-paper-scissors?

lunch2_dain_8.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_8.text: Ugh, fine, fine! I accept it! Ma'am, two soboro buns!

lunch2_dain_9.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_9.text: It's crowded, so let's lean by this window and eat. *We stand side by side by the shop's glass door with the warm bag of bread, and down the hall I see Seoyeon coming this way.*

lunch2_dain_11.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_11.text: Hey, what was that with the student council president? Why'd she stare at us like that and walk off?

lunch2_dain_12.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_12.text: I don't know. Maybe she just saw us while she was passing.

lunch2_dain_13.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_13.text: Hmm. Suspicious. Did you get really close with the president behind my back?

lunch2_dain_choice.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_choice.text: {name}, I just asked you. I'm not dropping this until I hear your answer. *She steps half a pace closer and stares up at my face, eyes steady.*
choices: She just showed me around the school?

lunch2_dain_c1_1.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_c1_1.text: ...Oh. So the two of you talked on your own yesterday, too. Then there's plenty between you that I don't know. *Bread still in her mouth, she fiddles with the end of the empty wrapper, and the chewing stops.*

lunch2_dain_c2_1.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_c2_1.text: Just a tour of the school... Fine. If that's what you say, I'll take it. *She takes another bite of the soboro, but glances at the faint trace of Seoyeon still on the shop's glass door.*

lunch2_dain_c3_1.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_c3_1.text: Hey, don't laugh like you're making fun of me! *Dain snaps the soboro bun in her hand in half and thrusts the bigger piece out toward my chest.* Don't make me talk. Eat more of this!

lunch2_dain_c3_2.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_c3_2.text: I gave it so you'd eat more. Why do you keep grinning? I'm not putting it in your mouth for you, so just take it! *As if to hide her reddened cheeks, she folds the bread wrapper down to the width of two finger joints.*

lunch2_dain_end.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end.text: *While Dain sulks and chews what's left of the bread, the shop's glass door Seoyeon brushed past still sways, faintly, like the moment hasn't left.*

lunch2_dain_end_b.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_b.text: *In afternoon 5th-period PE, I slam into a student from the next class who was chasing the ball. I fall, scrape my elbow, and red drops of blood bead up.*

lunch2_dain_end_c.name: PE Teacher
lunch2_dain_end_c.text: Dirt's in that cut. Get to the nurse's office and get it disinfected.

lunch2_dain_end_d.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_d.text: *I carefully open the nurse's office door and step in. The sharp antiseptic from yesterday, and a faint perfume, sink into my lungs again.*

lunch2_dain_end_e.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_e.text: *Sorting the charts, she looks up, and her eyes soften.* Oh. The transfer student from yesterday.

lunch2_dain_end_ins4_first.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins4_first.text: *I carefully open the nurse's office door, and a cool, sharp smell of antiseptic brushes my nose.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins5_first.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins5_first.text: *She closes the chart and looks at me over her glasses.* First time in the nurse's office today, right? You're the new transfer student?

lunch2_dain_end_f.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_f.text: I fell during PE and scraped my elbow a little.

lunch2_dain_end_g.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_g.text: Two days in a row? Already planning to become a regular in my office?

lunch2_dain_end_ins7_first.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins7_first.text: You can get hurt running on a field you don't know. Come here. Let's disinfect it first.

lunch2_dain_end_i.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_i.text: You're even putting a towel under my elbow? This is more of a setup than I expected. *The nurse takes out a bottle of disinfectant and white gauze, and gently props my elbow up from underneath.*

lunch2_dain_end_j.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_j.text: The disinfectant will sting a little. Relax your shoulder and your arm.

lunch2_dain_end_l.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_l.text: *She blows lightly over the wound, then presses a waterproof bandage on tight.* Don't move for a second. There. All done.

lunch2_dain_end_m.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_m.text: It's on already? It's right over the joint. Won't the bandage peel if I bend my arm? *The nurse wraps a hand around my wrist and signals me to bend my elbow once.*

lunch2_dain_end_n.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_n.text: Bend it slowly, once. Does the skin pull, or sting?

lunch2_dain_end_o.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_o.text: *I bend my arm deep and straighten it the way she holds it, but not one edge of the bandage lifts.*

lunch2_dain_end_p.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_p.text: A little trick I picked up at the hospital a long time ago. On a joint that moves a lot, you follow the line of the bend, or it won't stay on.

lunch2_dain_end_r.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_r.text: *The desk drawer is open to put the scissors away, and inside it I see a faded pale-green notebook. The moment I read the first line inside the cover, "To you, that day—", the drawer snaps shut.*

lunch2_dain_end_s.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_s.text: *She glances down at the closed drawer once, then looks me straight in the eye.* Pretend you didn't see what just went by. I'll tell you one secret instead. I like sweet cocoa much more than bitter coffee.

lunch2_dain_end_t.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_t.text: *Even after she offers the cocoa line like a joke, the nurse's pale fingers stay pressed hard on the drawer handle and don't let go.*

lunch2_dain_end_u.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_u.text: *Then she eases off the handle and slips her hand into her coat pocket.* That's enough of an adult's private talk for today. The bandage on your elbow isn't uncomfortable?

lunch2_dain_end_w.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_w.text: There. Treatment's done, so get back to class. When you shower tonight, keep the water off it.

lunch2_dain_end_x.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_x.text: Do I have to come back tomorrow and change it for a new bandage?

lunch2_dain_end_y.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_y.text: You don't have to change it every single day. Check the wound tomorrow morning and decide then. *Halfway through folding the empty bandage wrapper in half, she looks up at me with a peculiar look.*

lunch2_dain_end_z.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_z.text: If an edge lifts or it starts to weep, come straight to me. If it's fine, you can leave it on.

lunch2_dain_end_c2.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_c2.text: If the cut stings during the rest of PE, don't hold it in. Tell your teacher. Otherwise, stop by on a break.

lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short1.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short1.text: There, all done. Next time, don't run with your eyes only on the ball. Watch the people around you first.

lunch2_yuna_1.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_1.text: *The deserted old library annex. Cool shade settles over the far end of the hall, where Yuna leans by the window, reading alone.*

lunch2_yuna_4.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_4.text: I came because I saw the note you left on my desk this morning.

lunch2_yuna_5.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_5.text: You could've just ignored it and not come.

lunch2_yuna_7.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_7.text: In class you're always stuck with that loud one. Usually that's way more fun.

lunch2_yuna_8.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_8.text: Sometimes I need a quiet refuge too, just to catch my breath.

lunch2_yuna_4_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_4_seo.text: I even got a note you wrote yourself.

lunch2_yuna_5_seo.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_5_seo.text: Yesterday you were next to the president.

lunch2_yuna_6_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_6_seo.text: Today you were the one who called me aside.

lunch2_yuna_8_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_8_seo.text: It was a place you called me to, so I wanted to come even more.

lunch2_yuna_4_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_4_yuna.text: This time you even wrote the secret place on the note.

lunch2_yuna_5_yuna.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_5_yuna.text: The library was quiet the whole time yesterday. You're not bored today, either?

lunch2_yuna_6_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_6_yuna.text: Being with you yesterday was the most comfortable. So I came again.

lunch2_yuna_8_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_8_yuna.text: Yeah. Even without talking, being next to you didn't feel awkward at all.

lunch2_yuna_9.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_9.text: Follow me in. Kids pass through the hall sometimes. *She slips a bookmark into the page she was reading and walks ahead.*

lunch2_yuna_11.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_11.text: The wood floor makes the footsteps echo a bit, right? We're here. *She steps into a small inner room hung with faded velvet curtains.*

lunch2_yuna_13.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_13.text: What is this place? Your own secret reading room?

lunch2_yuna_14.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_14.text: Almost no one at school knows there's a room like this in a corner of the annex.

lunch2_yuna_15.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_15.text: If you just stand there, I can't focus enough to read. Sit. You don't have to ask permission for every little thing here. *She sinks into the small 2-seat sofa, sets her bag on the floor, and leaves the seat right beside her empty.*

lunch2_yuna_16.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_16.text: There used to be one other person who knew this room, besides me.

lunch2_yuna_17.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_17.text: There used to be one more?

lunch2_yuna_17_b.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_17_b.text: *The bookmark, pushed by Yuna's fingertips, slowly disappears between the pages. She never turns to the next one.*

lunch2_yuna_choice.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_choice.text: *A long silence settles after “used to be.” On the narrow sofa, sitting side by side, Yuna's cool shoulder is close enough to touch.*
choices: I can listen better than that person ever did.
Then you can just tell me everything from now on.

lunch2_yuna_c1_1.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_1.text: She left school. She transferred exactly 1 year ago.

lunch2_yuna_c1_2.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_2.text: *The tip of Yuna's pale finger presses the corner of the bookmark hard enough to drain the color from it.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_3.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_3.text: Without leaving me a single message.

lunch2_yuna_c1_4.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_4.text: *She pushes the bookmark in too deep, and a corner of the page creases, but Yuna never smooths it out.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_5.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_5.text: She never reached out at all, even after she transferred?

lunch2_yuna_c1_6.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_6.text: Hard to say. Whether she didn't on purpose, or just couldn't. I still don't know.

lunch2_yuna_c1_7.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_7.text: If it's hard to bring up, you don't have to force yourself to say more. *Yuna lifts the open book until it covers her up to the tip of her nose.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_9.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_9.text: Maybe she had to leave all of a sudden, too? When things are chaotic, people part without leaving word.

lunch2_yuna_c1_9_b.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_9_b.text: I know that's possible, in my head. But you don't know anything, so don't make excuses for that person. *She snaps the book shut.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_10.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_10.text: I only heard much later, from other people, that she'd already gone to another school. Before that, not a word to me.

lunch2_yuna_c1_11.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_11.text: That must have felt really empty.

lunch2_yuna_c1_12.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_12.text: ...Yeah. Let's just read our own books now. *She slowly smooths the creased page corner with her fingertip.*

lunch2_yuna_c2_1.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c2_1.text: *I don't ask anything more. When I quietly lean into the seat beside her, Yuna picks a book from the stack by her knee and sets it down close to my thigh.*

lunch2_yuna_c2_4.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c2_4.text: *In the pale sunlight past the curtain, the sound of the two of us turning pages alternates, like slow breaths.*

lunch2_yuna_c2_6.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c2_6.text: Why I like this little room.

lunch2_yuna_c2_8.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c2_8.text: It's quiet, like the world is cut off. — But today I'm not alone.

lunch2_yuna_c2_9.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c2_9.text: *Yuna turns toward the shelves as if to hide a slightly flushed cheek, but the open page doesn't turn for a long time.*

lunch2_yuna_end.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_end.text: *Before I close the annex door, I look back one last time. Yuna is looking down again at the very page she stopped on when she said “used to be.”*

lunch2_seo_trap_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_trap_1.text: *She quietly draws back the wet wipe she was holding out.* Right. You can handle that yourself.

lunch2_yuna_trap_compare.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_trap_compare.text: *Yuna slides the bookmark deep between the pages, drawing a firm line.* You and he aren't people to compare so lightly.

lunch2_yuna_trap_exclusive.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_trap_exclusive.text: *She pulls the book to her chest, then slowly lowers it.* I decide who I tell things to, and how much.

lunch2_seo_2_warm.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2_warm.text: You came up again today. Looks like you've already got a taste for my lunch.

lunch2_seo_2_cool.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2_cool.text: You're here. I'll open the lunch box now, so wait a second.

lunch2_seo_2_neg.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2_neg.text: *Without opening the lunch box, she only looks past the far railing.* I'm thinking about student council work right now. Don't stay long.

lunch2_seo_2b_warm.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2b_warm.text: You came all the way up here yourself today. I'll give you the nerve.

lunch2_seo_2b_cool.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2b_cool.text: The roof is student council permit only. I'll make an exception, just for today.

lunch2_dain_2_cool.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_2_cool.text: If you're here, get in the back of the line. You're paying for the bread today. You know that.

lunch2_dain_2_neg.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_2_neg.text: *She keeps one step of distance in the checkout line and only looks straight ahead.* I'm not in the mood for a bet today. Buy yours and go.

lunch2_yuna_3_cool.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_3_cool.text: *Without a word, she only slides in a bookmark, moves her bag, and leaves the seat beside her empty.*

lunch2_yuna_3_neg.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_3_neg.text: *She doesn't hand over a note. She only turns one page, cold.* I don't want to talk to anyone today.

lunch2_seo_neg_leave.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_neg_leave.text: *In the cold air, I quietly shut the roof door and go down the stairs.*

lunch2_dain_neg_leave.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_neg_leave.text: *I step out of the noisy snack-shop line and stand alone in the hallway.*

lunch2_yuna_neg_leave.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_neg_leave.text: *I shut the annex door and go down the stairs, keeping my steps quiet.*

lunch2_seo_cool_cont.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_cool_cont.text: *The lunch box lid opens quietly, and only a cool wind passes between us first.*

lunch2_dain_cool_cont.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_cool_cont.text: *I grab two soboro buns and finish paying. Dain takes only her share, without a word.*

lunch2_dain_cool_leave.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_cool_leave.text: *I finish paying and step into the hallway outside the shop. Dain doesn't look back and goes ahead to her classmates.*

lunch2_seo_cool_leave.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_cool_leave.text: *After an awkward silence, I close the lunch box and step out the iron roof door.*

lunch2_yuna_cool_cont.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_cool_cont.text: *In the quiet room, only my page turns. Yuna never takes the earphone out of her ear.*
